title: P2PStatusView
description: P2P node status for observability. Source of truth: libp2p Swarm state + in-memory replication tracker + SQLite drain query (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request. Not persisted.

listenAddresses.description: Multiaddrs this node is listening on

relayMode.description: Relay mode this node is running in

drain.description: Drain queue state. null when DB pool or query unavailable — treat as 'data not available', NOT 'caught up'

syncPaused.description: True when sync/replication is paused for backpressure (bulk write in progress). Operators and elohim agents use this to understand node load state.

dedupUniqueLen.description: D.7 dedup LRU: number of unique CIDs currently in the dedup window.

dedupTotalSeen.description: D.7 dedup LRU: cumulative insert calls (new + duplicate). Ratio (dedupTotalSeen - dedupUniqueLen) / dedupTotalSeen approximates duplication rate.

oneOf.description: Acquisition pull-queue rollup (spec 2026-06-07-epr-acquisition-pull-queue-design §4.3-4.4). null = cannot compute = keep waiting, never caught-up.

pull.description: Acquisition pull-queue rollup. null when state cannot be computed — treat as 'keep waiting', NEVER as caught up (spec §4.3).

oneOf.description: P1 projection-reconcile stream status (REA commitments converge from own conductor; peers as discovery). null when the reconcile task is not running.

projectionReconcile.description: P1 projection-reconcile stream status. null when the reconcile task is not running (missing lamad HcClient / pool / disabled).
